answer: By the karst of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A nectar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jetty of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work.
